title: The Wolf of Caerlum
author: Lena Yarrow
blurb: Noor Ashgrove, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
